name: Maximum Carnage
description: Carnage escapes Ravencroft and assembles a twisted family of killers, unleashing a city-wide massacre across Manhattan. Spider-Man and his allies must stop the symbiote-fueled rampage before New York drowns in chaos.
flavorText: There's no law. There's no order. There's only Carnage.
musicAIPrompt: Create a 45-second seamless loopable orchestral film score in the exact style of John Williams. Terror / Horror Sting. Symbiote-fueled Maximum Carnage massacre in Manhattan. Screaming strings and brutal percussion. Chaotic and horrific, wide stereo, instrumental only, perfectly loopable with no fade in/out.
